messages:
sara_prod: Kicking off prod rollout for model-service v2.3.1 at 03:00 UTC. Canary -> 5% traffic. I'll watch dashboards, call if we need to pause.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout_id=rl-2026-03-20-82, target=v2.3.1, stage=canary, traffic=5%

observify-bot: preflight checks OK except recent baseline drift on embed-service p95. p95 baseline=95ms current=130ms (source: slo-dashboard). No error increase detected.

ali_oncall: seeing a small uptick in cache miss rate on canary hosts, could explain p95 bump. digging into kvcache logs.

mike_releases: tagging this as watch-level: latency. If p95 > 150ms or 5xx > 1% for 3m -> pause. can we add a short alert rule in the deploy window?

nina_sre: setting a temp alert: alert_name=deploy-window-embed-p95, expr=p95(embed_service{env=prod,rollout=rl-2026-03-20-82}) > 150 for 3m. Notified: #eng-oncall, #eng-releases.

ali_oncall: confirmed cache miss spike on canary nodes. Root cause: new shard mapping didn't warm KV prefill. Rolling restart of canary nodes might fix.

sara_prod: do we want to pause traffic or attempt patch? risk of rollback vs fix. thoughts?

mike_releases: pause traffic to 1% while we test restart? prefer not to rollback given no 5xx yet.

deploy-bot: traffic scaled to 1% per policy (auto-mitigate). rollout stage=canary, traffic=1%

nina_sre: restart initiated on canary host list: canary-03, canary-04. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-service -l rollout=rl-2026-03-20-82 --namespace=prod-canary`

observify-bot: alert fired: deploy-window-embed-p95 -> p95=162ms (3m window). Notified oncall.

ali_oncall: after restart, cache miss rate dropping. p95 trending down to 110ms. 5xx still 0.2%.

sara_prod: great. keeping rollout at 1% for another 5m to validate. mike, any objection to resuming to 5% after 5m if stable?

mike_releases: agree. if 5xx stays <0.5% and p95 < 140ms we ramp. document decision in release notes: note transient kv-cache warmup issue, mitigated by restart.

deploy-bot: scheduled traffic ramp to 5% in 5m unless halted.

nina_sre: adding postmortem note TODO: include kvcache warmup as a checklist item in preflight for future rollouts.

ali_oncall: continuing to monitor. if error budget burn > 2% within 10m, escalate to rollback.

sara_prod: thanks team. will update the release thread and mark the rollout as observed.

mike_releases: small follow-up: add a short smoke test (KV read-heavy) to the canary probe so we catch warmup misses earlier.

sara_prod: noted. creating a ticket and linking to the rollout. :white_check_mark:
